info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Loan Application API
info.description: The Loan Application API facilitates the submission of loan applications for consumers seeking financial lending services. By utilizing this API, users can input essential loan details, including amounts, terms, and personal information. It streamlines the application process for both individuals and businesses. Typical users include bank representatives, lending institutions, and financial service providers who require a seamless digital platform to manage loan requests efficiently.

post.summary: Initiate a loan under deposit lending.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new loan application within the deposit lending system. Users can submit necessary details for processing their loan request.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a loan transaction under the deposit lending service. The body must adhere to the specified schema for successful processing.
